gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.
